name: Blood Transfusion
overview: Scripture reveals the sacredness of blood as the life of the flesh, forbidding the consumption of blood as emphasized in Genesis 9:4, Leviticus 3:17, and Deuteronomy 12:16. Blood is not only life but also the means of atonement, given by God to be offered on the altar for the forgiveness of sins (Leviticus 17:11). The repeated commands against eating blood and the severe warnings in Leviticus 17:10 and 17:14 underscore its holiness and the seriousness with which God regards the proper handling of blood, which has direct implications for understanding practices like blood transfusions in a biblical context.
